message.content: In July, Hailey Johnson reached out to Li Hua regarding her new artisanal donuts, seeking feedback on their quality and preferences. Specifically, Hailey asked Li Hua which flavor she enjoyed the most among the artisanal donuts and whether she had any additional suggestions for flavors to incorporate into the lineup. Li Hua responded positively, expressing her appreciation for the chocolate hazelnut flavor and offering a suggestion for a seasonal fruit flavor, such as raspberry or lemon. This indicates that Hailey values customer feedback to enhance and diversify her product offerings.
